data.name: Bhargav
data.gender_notes: Bhargav is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bhargav is the name of Lord Vedavyasa, who is considered the author of the Mahabharata and the Bhagavad Gita. He is the god of speech, wisdom and knowledge. The name Bhargav carries the meaning “God of Speech” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bhargav usually hope their child will grow to embody god of speech and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Bhargav belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Speech.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bhargav total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
